posts.text: Kaboly doesn’t think Tyreek Hill is a possibility to the Steelers at this point: “That was a very significant injury. For a player whose game is built on speed, that's tough because while you might be able to get back on the field in eight to ten months, you're usually not truly back to yourself for 16 to 18 months. I don't know if the juice is worth the squeeze there. But if you're desperate, maybe you at least consider it. I don't know how desperate they are right now when it comes to bringing in Tyreek Hill. Everything points to no for me. The fact that no one else seems interested is a red flag in itself. There's usually a reason for that. Would he come in on a minimum deal? Probably not. Would he agree to a practice squad role? Probably not. There are just a lot of complications. My guess is he'd wait things out until the trade deadline, when teams start getting more aggressive because they weren't able to complete trades. So I would lean against it, but I'd at least make the call and see where his mindset is and what exactly he's looking for.” #Steelers #NFL
